items.docs: Retrieve AgentOS metrics and analytics data for a specified date range. If no date range is specified, returns all available metrics.

items.docs: Manually trigger recalculation of system metrics from raw data. This operation analyzes system activity logs and regenerates aggregated metrics. Useful for ensuring metrics are up-to-date or after system maintenance.
